title: Unresolved loci and codimension-stratum data of ordinary blowup towers
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. For a finite ordinary blowup tower $R$ on $X$ with its ordered ideal centers [def-trf-ordinary-resolution-rule], define its unresolved set $T(R)$ to be the image in $X$ of the singular locus of its terminal scheme, together with the images of the singular loci of all its scheme-theoretic centers; singular means that the local ring is not regular [def-weil-regular-scheme]. For a subset $Z\subseteq |X|$ and $r\in\mathbb N$, define $S_r(X,Z)=\{x\in Z:\dim\mathcal O_{X,x}=r\}$, where dimension is Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Define $G_X(Z)$ to be the image in $X$ of the generic points of irreducible components of the subspace $Z$. Define $I_X(S)$ to be the vanishing ideal of $\overline S$, so its closed subscheme is the reduced closure [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. For a morphism $p:W\to X$, say that $W$ is schematically dense over the generic points of its image when, for every open $U\subseteq W$ and section $a\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_W)$, if $a_w=0$ in $\mathcal O_{W,w}$ for every $w\in U$ with $p(w)\in G_X(p(W))$, then $a=0$.
